notes: Descry counts execute the real walker, chunkers and WordPiece tokenizer. No ONNX execution or index writes. Token lengths capped at 256; global exact-text dedup models successful persistent cache reuse. Concurrent duplicate cache misses can increase model calls up to chunks.

Mimirs counts reconstruct production window planning and per-file/per-1024-document dedup from the restored published index. Existing probe has fixed corpus labels; mimirs aliases Kubernetes, other two alias the small Mimirs corpus. Only the first population is Kubernetes.

Mimirs capture also embeds three sampled references plus model initialization; this is not a new full indexing or throughput benchmark. Descry scan timings include diagnostic full-text tokenization and dedup and ran alongside the Rust capture, so they are not production chunking benchmark results.

User confirms Apple M3, q8 model and three CPUs for an 11-minute result reported July 21. First public commit is July 26 and uses AST declarations; tree-sitter introduction was authored August 1 and committed August 2. Older declaration mode is likely, but the exact private July 21 code/runtime, hardware variant, corpus and cache state remain unknown.
